recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-44932; future maintenance of the deprecated specimen-processingTime extension belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-44932 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 change request to add timeDuration to Specimen.processing.time[x] as part of the FHIR-44361 path for deprecating/replacing the specimen-processingTime extension.
initial_application: No core commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-44932 was found. The same source requirement had already been applied in commit 2e47a771ff78f16314747f5451f30a1f80317784 for FHIR-40950, which inserted the Duration type into source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml under Specimen.processing.time[x].
additional_context: FHIR-40950 is the same-change-family core tracker that requested duration on Specimen.processing.time and removal of the specimen-processingTime extension. FHIR-44361 is the Extension Pack tracker that connected deprecating specimen-processingTime with creating FHIR-44932. OO minutes on 2024-03-08 and 2024-03-22 record the extension-pack decision, FHIR-44932 creation/block handling, and the persuasive disposition. Zulip discussion in #Orders and Observation WG also points the processingTime extension question to approved FHIR-40950.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Specimen is active in source/fhir.ini, and the authoritative StructureDefinition already lists dateTime, Period, and Duration for Specimen.processing.time[x], which generates the requested timeDuration choice.
